query: PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX r: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/refinement/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?facility WHERE { t:assessment l:assessmentScenario/r:scenarioFacility ?facility }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX r: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/refinement/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?record ?case ?claim WHERE { ?record r:caseIdentifier ?case ; r:carrierClaim ?claim }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX r: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/refinement/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?org ?status ?time WHERE { ?result l:pvResultAssessment/r:assessmentOrganization ?org ; l:signalStatus ?status ; l:atTime ?time }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX r: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/refinement/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?product ?capability WHERE { t:service r:serviceProduct ?product ; l:serviceCapability ?capability }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX r: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/refinement/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?org ?source WHERE { t:agreement r:agreementCommitment ?claim . ?claim r:commitmentActor ?org . ?e c:evidenceAssertion ?claim ; c:evidenceRecord ?source }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX r: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/refinement/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?manufacturing ?product ?facility WHERE { t:transform r:supportsManufacturing ?manufacturing . ?manufacturing r:manufacturingProduct ?product ; r:manufacturingFacility ?facility }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX r: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/refinement/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?responsible ?operator WHERE { t:transform r:activityResponsibleOrganization ?responsible ; l:digitalActivityDeployment/l:deploymentOrganization ?operator }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX r: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/refinement/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?source ?requirement WHERE { t:surveillance l:surveillanceSource ?source ; l:surveillanceRequirement ?requirement }
